fusions.name: Hamstring
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. It deals 18 slashing damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage.

fusions.name: Scything Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a fan of cuts 3 tiles ahead that deals 4 slashing damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each hit [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut as it Passes
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: After Dusk
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 12% more damage. You gain 5% dodge chance.
